description: Settings of a connected social account: daily_limit (posts per day, null = platform default), route (api | web), web_agent_id (browser agent that posts on the web route), language (de | en, default language for queued posts), tiktok_mode (inbox = draft in the TikTok app, direct = publish; direct needs TikTok's audit). Called by an agent, the change is parked.

route.description: api = platform API, web = hand over to a browser agent

web_agent_id.description: agent that posts on the web route (needs a browser)

name: update_social_account
